name: Kuga Kagerou
source:
He may look young, but according to his family registry, he is Shiou's older brother. He is actually a homunculus who was created to destroy Serahime's soul, just like Shiou.

He looks bright and innocent, but actually has a cruel personality.

[Translated from [url=http://www.ignote.net/operetta/tumikui/character.html]official website[/url]]
